title: Architecture Language v9A.3
description: Masterpiece OS Space Generator Phase 9A.3 Architecture Bridge Output. v9A.3 是 Phase 9A Spatial Intent Reasoning 的 Bridge layer, 输入 compiledSpatialIntent (Phase 9A.2) 编译为 architectureLanguage. 5 字段: spatialPrinciples / architecturalCharacteristics / materialDirection / lightDirection / spatialOrganization. 不调真实 Provider, 不修改 Prompt Runtime (Phase 9A.3 §11.4 验收). 与 Phase 8D architecture-language/registry.json 4 类 (organic-flow / translucent-boundary / soft-light-system / material-continuity) 不同层级: 4 类是 industryIndependent 分类, 5 字段是 per-DNA 编译输出.

spatialPrinciples.description: Phase 9A.3 §7.1: 空间原则. 例如 'gradual transition / controlled openness / balanced privacy'. 禁止: 直接指定装饰元素.

architecturalCharacteristics.description: Phase 9A.3 §7.2: 建筑特征. 例如 'continuous spatial flow / soft boundary / quiet hierarchy'. 不是: 某种具体造型 / 某个参考图复制.

materialDirection.description: Phase 9A.3 §7.3: 材料方向 (高层, 不是具体材质). 例如 'calm mineral texture / natural translucent surface'. 错误: 使用某品牌同款石材.

lightDirection.description: Phase 9A.3 §7.4: 光环境逻辑. 例如 'indirect illumination / soft natural transition'. 禁止: 固定颜色灯光.

spatialOrganization.description: Phase 9A.3 §7.5: 空间组织. 例如 'gradual privacy transition / clear user circulation'.

weight.description: Optional. Phase 9B 集成时, architectureLanguage 对 prompt 编译时的强调强度. 0=不强调, 1=最强. Phase 9A.3 推荐 0.25 (与 architectureFunctionBridge.weightBoost 对齐).

frozen_by: Space Generator v1.1 Phase 9A.3 Architecture Bridge
